summary: The bounding box of the yellow(4) cells IS the template (always 3x3 in the demos: yellow body cells plus magenta(6) marker cells, no holes; yellow appears nowhere else). For each of the 8 dihedral orientations of the template, slide it over the grid (bottom/right one-cell overhang allowed). A position matches when every in-bounds template-6 cell sits on a grid-6 cell, no in-bounds template-4 cell sits on a grid-6 cell, and at least 2 template-6 cells hit a grid-6. On a match, every in-bounds template-4 cell is painted 4. The demos are dense fields of noise colors 0/1/8 with ~10-13% magenta, so matches emerge from the noise.
